backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor defining data types (User, Store, OrderRecord, DistributorDelivery) and their in-memory maps, with role-based access control via MixinAuthorization and helper functions for user lookup, admin checks, and unique ID generation.
backend/migration.mo: Data migration module that upgrades the users map by adding an `id` field (set to the user's email) to each existing OldUser record and resets the userIdCounter to 0.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing two implemented features: fixing the user ID display in the UserManagementPage table and fixing the login flow so dynamically created users can authenticate, with associated file paths, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: A JSON-formatted text file containing one-sentence summaries of each frontend source file, documenting the purpose and key changes made to each component, page, hook, and context.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS entry point defining OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for the light and dark color themes, including background, foreground, sidebar, chart, and semantic UI token variables.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the Vite/React app, setting the page title to 'Vitalist Water — Order & Delivery Management' and mounting the React app via the root div and main.tsx module script.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that wraps the app in QueryClientProvider, ThemeProvider, and AuthProvider, then renders role-based page routing via a currentPage state with a loading screen during session restoration.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/StatCa: Reusable dashboard stat card component that displays a label, numeric count, icon, and optional trend text with color-coded styling based on a predefined color map.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppSideba: Defines the application sidebar with role-based navigation items, rendering only the nav links visible to the current user's role along with a brand header and role badge.
frontend/src/components/layout/Layout.ts: Main layout shell that composes the sidebar, a responsive top header with user info and logout, and a scrollable main content area with a toast provider.
frontend/src/components/orders/StatusBad: Small presentational component that renders a colored pill badge with an icon for a given order status string.
frontend/src/components/qr/QRCodeDisplay: Displays a QR code image fetched via URL for a given order ID, with a text fallback if the image fails to load.
frontend/src/components/qr/QRScanModal.t: Modal dialog that activates the device camera to scan QR codes, decodes the result into an order ID, and calls back the parent on success.
frontend/src/contexts/AuthContext.tsx: Provides authentication state (user, token, login, logout) backed by sessionStorage for persistence, calling the ICP backend actor's login method and exposing role-based helpers.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React Query hook that creates and caches an ICP backend actor instance, using the current Internet Identity and invalidating dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an Internet Identity context and provider that manages AuthClient lifecycle, login/logout flow, and exposes the current identity and login status to child components.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Provides React Query hooks for CRUD operations on stores, orders, users, and distributor deliveries, along with role mapping utilities between frontend AppRole and backend AppUserRole types.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines global CSS variables for a water-blue themed design system (light/dark modes), Tailwind base/component/utility layers, and status badge styles for order states.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that mounts the React app with QueryClientProvider, InternetIdentityProvider, and the root App component.
frontend/src/pages/admin/DistributorDeli: Admin page for managing distributor deliveries, supporting create, edit, and delete operations via a dialog form and table view with mutations from custom hooks.
frontend/src/pages/admin/OrderManagement: Admin page for viewing and managing all orders with search/filter support, displaying order stats and allowing status transitions (approve, dispatch, deliver, cancel).
frontend/src/pages/admin/QRManagementPag: Admin page that displays QR codes for orders containing QR data, with search filtering and summary stats for total, active, and completed QR codes.
frontend/src/pages/admin/ReportsPage.tsx: Admin analytics page that computes and displays order statistics (today, week, month, totals), top stores by order count, and order status distribution using bar charts.
frontend/src/pages/admin/StoreManagement: Admin page for managing stores with full CRUD operations, including a form dialog with geolocation support and a searchable table listing all stores.
frontend/src/pages/admin/UserManagementP: Admin page for managing users with full CRUD operations, supporting role assignment (admin/staff/delivery/distributor) via a dialog form and searchable user table.
frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx: Dashboard page that displays order statistics (today's orders, pending, ready, out for delivery, delivered) as stat cards and shows a list of the 5 most recent orders.
frontend/src/pages/delivery/DeliveryDash: Delivery personnel dashboard showing dispatched and out-for-delivery orders, with QR scan support to advance order status and GPS-based distance display.
frontend/src/pages/distributor/Distribut: Distributor dashboard displaying assigned deliveries with truck/driver details, allowing distributors to mark truck arrival and view order status with skeleton loading states.
frontend/src/pages/LoginPage.tsx: Login page with email/password form that calls the AuthContext login function and shows loading state during Internet Identity authentication.
frontend/src/pages/ScanPage.tsx: QR scan page supporting three role-based scanning stages (admin, staff, delivery) that advance order statuses and optionally capture GPS coordinates for delivery scans.
frontend/src/pages/SettingsPage.tsx: Displays the current user's account information (name, email, role) and system info, with a sign-out button that calls the auth context logout function.
frontend/src/pages/staff/OrderCreationPa: Staff page for creating new orders by selecting a store, entering quantity and rate, and submitting for admin approval with a generated order ID.
frontend/src/utils/geoUtils.ts: Utility module providing geolocation helpers including Haversine distance calculation, distance formatting, current position retrieval, and Google Maps URL generation.
frontend/src/utils/orderUtils.ts: Provides utility functions and types for order management, including parsing/building order metadata embedded in notes, generating order IDs and invoice numbers, encoding/decoding QR data, and mapping order statuses to display colors and icons.
frontend/src/utils/qrGenerator.ts: Generates QR code image URLs for order IDs using the qrserver.com external API, encoding order data as base64 before passing it as the QR payload.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides utilities for reading URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routes, persisting them to sessionStorage, and cleaning sensitive parameters from the URL bar without page reload.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration that sets up dark mode, custom fonts, an extended color palette (including ocean, aqua, and sidebar tokens using OKLCH), and includes the typography, container-queries, and animate plugins.
project_state.json: Tracks the overall project state (version 27) for the Vitalist Water order and delivery management system, documenting architectural decisions, known bugs (broken admin permissions, missing distributor role in Add User, geolocation issues), and the list of implemented features.
